# HVAC Marketing HQ

> HVAC Marketing HQ builds websites, runs Google Business Profiles and sets up missed-call text-back and review requests for HVAC contractors. HVAC only, serving HVAC companies nationally.

## Quick facts
- Website: https://hvacmarketinghq.com
- Email: hello@hvacmarketinghq.com
- Who it serves: residential and light commercial HVAC contractors
- Main offer: a free report card that grades an HVAC company's Google profile, reviews, website and listings against nearby competitors
- Guarantees: every missed call texted back within 60 seconds; new site live within 14 days of receiving content; first month refunded if the client is unhappy in the first 30 days after launch
- Does not promise: #1 rankings, a set number of jobs, a fixed cost per lead, or AI assistant recommendations
- Ownership: the client owns their domain, website content, Google profile and reviews

## Method: Rank, Book, Repeat
- Rank: Show up first when someone searches. A fast site built around the jobs you want; A page for each service and each town you really serve; Google profile complete, active and posting the job photos you send; Directory listings kept consistent; Map spam reported on fake competitor listings.
- Book: Every call answered and booked, even when you can't pick up. Missed-call text-back in 60 seconds, guaranteed; One shared inbox for calls, texts, chats and forms; AI web chat that captures the lead after hours; Estimate follow-up until the job is booked or lost; Optional AI phone answering during the rush.
- Repeat: Turn every job into the next one. Review request after every finished job; A reply to every review, in your voice; Spring and fall tune-up campaigns to past customers; Maintenance plan reminders before plans lapse; Your HQ Command Center dashboard and a quarterly re-grade.

## Plans
- Starter (5 pages · 1 city; best for 1 to 2 trucks): $499/month, or 20% less billed yearly
- Growth (12 pages · 3 cities; best for 3 to 8 trucks): $899/month, or 20% less billed yearly
- Dominate (25 pages · 10 cities; best for 8+ trucks or a wide area): $1,499/month, or 20% less billed yearly
- Multi-location (Up to 10 locations; best for several branches or brands): $2,499/month, or 20% less billed yearly

## Good fit
HVAC shops that do good work, miss calls when the crew is busy, and want to own their marketing rather than rent leads.

## Not a fit
Shops that can't take on more work, want only Google Ads management, or want a one-time website with nothing after.
